    marker=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg and not any(r==br and c in bc for br,bc,_ in bars)]
    if len(bars)>=2 and marker:
        fill=marker[0][2]; width=len(marker)
        r0,c0,col=bars[0]; r1,c1,_=bars[-1]
        direction=1 if sum(c0)/len(c0)<w/2 else -1
        edge=max(c0) if direction==1 else min(c0)
        cols=range(edge+direction, edge+direction*(width+1), direction)
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):

    # Marker chain: turn its points to 4 and grow its color as a widening staircase

            width=r-r0
